title: Implement the durable computerless turn path
description:
Implement only what the computerless-turn stories require.

Scope:
- Tenant-scoped channel, message, turn, attempt, and event persistence in DynamoDB.
- One logical SQS turn job created after the inbound message is durable.
- A computerless worker that runs one OpenAI text-only loop.
- Durable coalesced progress and one committed answer.
- Authenticated POST and one-turn SSE endpoints using the transport proven by the spike.

Do not adapt the obsolete in-memory subscription into a second supported path.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Manager review 2026-08-30 of 341e42e (HTTP SSE send-back): accepted as the in-process thin-turn front door. The previous reject (in-process TurnStreamWatcher as the product stream) is addressed.

What now exists:
- FastAPI POST/GET channels and messages, POST /turns/{id}/chunks, GET /turns/{id}/stream with media type text/event-stream
- Behave/pytest drive that HTTP surface through uvicorn, not a private kernel subscription
- ComputerlessWorker posts chunks only through HttpTurnClient
- FakeTextCompletionClient remains the CI default
- cpu-only jobs; computer stays stopped

What this is not:
- Not merged to main
- Not the deployed Lambda/CloudFront path (that is chatticus-e5c86e)
- Live events still fan out in-process behind the HTTP generator; the DynamoDB poll-by-streaming-function shape still belongs to deploy, not this task
- Still no live OpenAI client (new task for gpt-5.6-luna + .env)

Do not close until the branch is on main with green CI. Do not start computer/browser/Vultus work from this issue.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Landed on develop (HTTP SSE thin turn, in-process FastAPI, fake OpenAI for CI). Not a production release; that is still main / chatticus-e5c86e. Closing the implementation task.
